channel.title: The English Garden - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The English Garden (theenglishgarden.co.uk)

item.title: Discover the story behind how artificial-flower-maker Anne Tomlin creates lifelike blooms from her West Sussex studio
item.description: Experienced milliner Anne Tomlin has found a second act to her long career, making exquisitely detailed artificial flowers inspired by nature.

item.title: How to grow and care for a fiddle leaf fig – the simple secrets to lush, glossy leaves that transform your space
item.description: A fiddle leaf fig is a dramatic statement houseplant, but they can be a tad fussy about their routine, so to have success, there are a few care considerations you need to keep in mind.

item.title: How to get rid of aphids – the quick-response plan gardeners use when plants start to suffer
item.description: Perhaps the most common of all garden insect pests, the blanket term ‘aphid’ includes many species of greenfly and blackfly that target a range of different plants. Often, little or no treatment is required, as these creatures are eaten by many other garden animals.

item.title: How to grow sweetpeas – fill your garden and your life with breathtaking colour, intoxicating fragrance, and endless summer blooms
item.description: At Easton Walled Gardens in Lincolnshire, sweet peas bloom in spellbinding profusion each summer. Lady Ursula Cholmeley shares how the gardens grow such a beautiful, fragrant display.

item.title: The best garden birdbaths – the standout designs that turn even small gardens into wildlife hotspots
item.description: Serving both a practical and decorative function, bird baths are an elegant addition to the garden space and a focal point that attracts and serves the needs of wildlife.

item.title: The Spring 2026 issue of The English Garden is now on sale
item.description: The English Garden’s Spring issue focuses on stylish plant-packed small gardens, and the prettiest flowers of the season

item.title: The best lawn seed for a fuller, greener lawn - the strongest, most resilient mixes tested for busy gardens
item.description: Growing a new lawn from seed may take a bit more time than laying turf, but it’s definitely better for your budget.

item.title: Stylish indoor herb garden ideas to bring fresh flavour and greenery into your home all year round
item.description: From neat rows of pots on a windowsill to vertical planters to newer smart garden models, the best herb garden ideas will maximise your space and help you grow abundantly.

item.title: Could this be the perfect weekend dish? Alexandra Dudley’s fennel, thyme and crème fraiche gratin is impressive, delicious and easy to make for two or a crowd
item.description: Fennel and onions are first cooked slowly on the hob until soft, and then baked in the oven with some nutmeg-spiked crème fraîche and a smattering of grated cheese

item.title: The best herb garden ideas for creating a functional and beautiful kitchen garden at home
item.description: One of the most rewarding additions to your green space is a herb garden. Simple and rewarding, for chefs, they bring fresh flavour, fragrance, and gorgeous greenery, whilst being versatile and easy to grow.

item.title: A cinch to make and tasty, too: herby meatballs with green tahini
item.description: Loaded with fresh mint, dill, parsley and coriander, these meatballs are light, zesty and great for a quick midweek supper, says Alexandra Dudley

item.title: 6 DIY compost bin ideas that will save you money and transform your garden
item.description: Nutrient-rich compost is the ultimate soil conditioner and essential for a flourishing garden. The great news is that there is a composting bin to suit every kind of garden and gardener. Pick one that suits your needs and space.

item.title: Experts pick the best summer-flowering bulbs for months of bright colour
item.description: Planted in spring, summer-flowering bulbs put on a spectacular show later in the season. Four experts pick their must-haves for summer colour

item.title: Win a brand new Danube cascading water feature from Charles Bentley
item.description: Outdoor furniture brand Charles Bentley is offering one lucky English Garden reader the chance to win its brand new Danube Cascading Water Feature, worth £109.

item.title: Spring lawn care secrets that can turn a dull, patchy yard into a lush green showpiece fast
item.description: It’s that time of year to start paying attention to your lawn, particularly since lawn care jobs carried out now in spring are the ones that will help get the grass in the best possible shape for the summer to come.
